description:
Customize Windows 11/10 system font with 100% system coverage across UWP, Win32, WinUI 3, Electron, etc and safely restore with one click.


What's New in v5.0:
- Direct GitHub font repository integration: browse and download curated fonts directly in the app
- Automatic variant detection and smart font matching
- Dark mode and light mode dynamic modern installer with high-DPI assets
- Full system font coverage across modern UWP/WinUI and classic Win32 applications
- Single-click restore to default Windows system fonts
⭐ Star the repo, it helps others discover it: https://github.com/karnyadavdev/FontWizard
